queries: OpenAI Stargate Abilene up and running five new sites announcement

sources_considered.why: Primary OpenAI post. Shows Abilene running by September 2025 and Stargate defined as OpenAI's overarching infrastructure platform.
Reports OpenAI's growth to 900M+ weekly users and $2B a month in revenue.

receipt.public_excerpt: the flagship Stargate campus in Abilene, Texas, which is already up and running on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and continues to progress rapidly. Oracle began delivering the first NVIDIA GB200 racks in June.

evidence_items.explanation: Stargate did start getting built and came online. So the counterfactual the claim depends on (growth without Stargate) did not occur.

receipt.public_excerpt: five new U.S. AI data center sites under Stargate, OpenAI’s overarching AI infrastructure platform.

evidence_items.explanation: Stargate was redefined as an umbrella that includes CoreWeave projects. That blurs the line between Stargate and other capacity.

receipt.public_excerpt: ChatGPT has more than 900 million weekly active users and more than 50 million subscribers, OpenAI said.

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI did grow much further after the post. But this happened while Stargate was being built, so it does not show whether Stargate was necessary.

unresolved_gaps: Stargate was in fact built and came online, so we never saw whether OpenAI could grow much further without it.
No source splits OpenAI's growth by compute source (Stargate versus Microsoft, CoreWeave, or other clouds).
